name: Neuro Navigator
tagline: When the Eye Signals the Brain
description: Pupillary pathways, cranial nerves, optic neuropathies, visual field defects, transient vision loss, headache workup, papilledema, and when to image.

episodes.title: The Afferent Pupillary Pathway: From Retina to Midbrain
episodes.description: Tracing the light reflex through the optic nerve, chiasm, and pretectal nucleus — and where lesions break it.

episodes.title: The Edinger-Westphal Nucleus and the Efferent Pupil
episodes.description: The parasympathetic output, the third nerve, and the ciliary ganglion that completes the reflex arc.

episodes.title: Anisocoria in the Light: The Parasympathetic Problem
episodes.description: When the larger pupil is the abnormal one — Adie’s tonic pupil, pharmacologic, and third nerve palsy.

episodes.title: Anisocoria in the Dark: The Sympathetic Problem
episodes.description: When the smaller pupil is the abnormal one — Horner syndrome and the cocaine and apraclonidine tests.

episodes.title: Horner Syndrome: The Triad and the Lesion Localization
episodes.description: Ptosis, miosis, and anhidrosis — central, preganglionic, and postganglionic localization by history and imaging.

episodes.title: Adie’s Tonic Pupil: The Light-Near Dissociation
episodes.description: The vermiform movements, the sectoral palsy, and the Ross syndrome that extends beyond the eye.

episodes.title: Third Nerve Palsy: The Pupil-Sparing Rule and Its Exceptions
episodes.description: When to image urgently, the aneurysm versus microvascular distinction, and the aberrant regeneration signs.

episodes.title: Fourth Nerve Palsy: The Head Tilt and the Parks Three-Step
episodes.description: The superior oblique palsy, the compensatory head tilt, and the three-step test that localizes it.

episodes.title: Sixth Nerve Palsy: The Abducens and Its Long Path
episodes.description: The elevated intracranial pressure link, the microvascular cause, and the recovery timeline.

episodes.title: Optic Neuritis: The ONTT and the MRI Decision
episodes.description: The acute vision loss, the pain on eye movement, and the high-dose steroid and MS workup protocol.

episodes.title: Ischemic Optic Neuropathy: Arteritic Versus Non-Arteritic
episodes.description: The GCA emergency, the ESR/CRP, and the temporal artery biopsy pathway that follows.

episodes.title: Giant Cell Arteritis: The Steroids Before the Biopsy
episodes.description: The jaw claudication, the scalp tenderness, and the immediate high-dose steroid that prevents bilateral blindness.

episodes.title: Papilledema: The Bilateral Disc Swelling of Raised ICP
episodes.description: The Frisén grading, the headache and pulsatile tinnitus, and the urgent neuroimaging that follows.

episodes.title: Pseudotumor Cerebri: The Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension
episodes.description: The young obese woman, the empty sella, and the weight loss and acetazolamide that manage it.

episodes.title: Optic Disc Drusen: The Pseudopapilledema
episodes.description: The buried calcification, the spontaneous venous pulsations, and the B-scan and OCT that confirm.
